subject: gov.policy
name: Domesticated geospatial information framework action plan
position_start: no government interoperability framework, no enterprise architecture framework, no data quality framework and no government service bus, on a 2022 structured assessment
position_end: a national action plan to domesticate the UN integrated geospatial information framework, intended to improve integration and interoperability of geospatial information and national data systems

subject: gov.legislate
name: Artificial intelligence law and strategy
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — a June 2026 legal-status review found no AI law, no national strategy and no institution with a mandate
position_start: no dedicated artificial-intelligence law, no national strategy, no data-protection statute and no data-protection authority
position_end: unchanged, on a review dated 8 June 2026, with an index scoring the government zero on policy capacity

subject: gov.legislate
name: Bank of Eritrea cash-deposit legal notice
milestone: Legal notice issued (~30 Jun 2026) ordering cash held outside banks deposited by 31 Jul 2026 or face legal action
position_end: In force; no definition given of an 'excessive amount' held outside banks, and no enforcement mechanism specified; deposit deadline 31 Jul 2026
sources: 2026-07-02 Eritrea's banking ultimatum - deposit cash by 31 July 2026
note: Reported via opposition/diaspora outlet Awate.com (adversarial framing), with the Bank of Eritrea's own notice text quoted in full; context for the near-total absence of mobile money in a cash-based, under-banked economy under a state banking monopoly

subject: gov.legislate
name: Computer-offence provisions of the 2015 Penal Code
position_start: two computer-offence articles in the general Penal Code and no dedicated cybersecurity statute, national response team or strategy
position_end: unchanged: nothing in the window amended the articles or created any of the missing apparatus

subject: gov.legislate
name: Electronic transactions and e-commerce framework
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — no electronic transactions framework in force; the only texts located are unofficial consultation drafts
position_start: no comprehensive digital-trade legal framework, on a regional trade regulatory profile
position_end: unchanged in law; the only texts addressing electronic transactions are unofficial consultation drafts published by a diaspora legal-reform initiative
note: the draft commercial code and payment systems act are an unofficial civil-society initiative, not a government process

subject: gov.legislate
name: Freedom of information law
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — a UN review contribution states plainly that no freedom of information law has been adopted
position_start: no freedom of information law adopted, against a constitutional guarantee of access to information that has never been in force
position_end: unchanged, and a press-freedom ranking placing Eritrea last of 180 for the third consecutive year

subject: gov.legislate
name: Nationality Proclamation 21/1992
position_start: a nationality proclamation providing the legal basis for nationality certification, with no digital-identity, electronic-identity, biometric or electronic-transactions provision
position_end: unchanged: no dedicated digital-identity statute was located at the probe date

subject: gov.legislate
name: Statistics law
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — a draft statistical proclamation was recorded pending in 2007 and no later enactment was located
position_start: a draft statistical proclamation submitted to government and still pending, so the statistics office has never operated under an enacted statistics law
position_end: unchanged: no later record of enactment was located at the probe date

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-protection law
position_start: no comprehensive data-protection law, no supervisory authority and no published enforcement decisions
position_end: unchanged, on a verification pass dated 1 August 2026

subject: gov.regional
name: Regional shared digital infrastructure
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — regional infrastructure planning treats Eritrea as a gap to be closed rather than a connected participant
position_start: a regional infrastructure master plan treating Eritrea as a connectivity gap whose interconnection to neighbours or submarine landing points should be implemented in the short term
position_end: unchanged: a later regional overview records that planned cable and data-infrastructure projects lack a commitment to serve Asmara

subject: gov.standards
name: Eritrean Standards Institution
position_start: an autonomous institution as sole national organ for standardisation, quality assurance and metrology, with the international system of units adopted as the legal measurement system
position_end: unchanged: nothing in the window amended the proclamation or recorded a digital or data standard made under it

subject: gov.discourse
name: Non-governmental contribution to national policy
position_start: an education ICT policy committing the state to narrowing the digital divide and to access for all citizens regardless of gender or location
position_end: a first national development plan described as drafted through participatory consultation, and technical geodesign workshops in Asmara bringing government, academic, private-sector and non-governmental participants together

subject: gov.discourse
name: Public discussion of government policy
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — no independent press, permitted civil society or public forum in which policy could be argued
position_start: a UN commission finding that the state systematically silences criticism, with surveillance and punishment producing self-censorship in private settings
position_end: unchanged, and a press-freedom ranking placing Eritrea last of 180 for the third consecutive year

subject: finance.mou
name: African Development Bank financial-sector modernisation dialogue
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: a bank delegation mission in April 2026 reviewing continued dialogue on a prospective financial sector modernisation project covering data systems

subject: finance.new
name: UNDP 'Economic & Social Data Development Eritrea' grant (IATI 00099544)
milestone: UNDP commits US$1,676,837 grant to the Government of Eritrea / National Statistics Office
position_end: Committed 2019, end year 2026 per IATI record; funds NSO statistical-capacity building, including the EPHS 2025 survey under the same D4D programme (see data.statistics)

subject: infra.connect
name: EriTel national network expansion programme
milestone: Minister reports 184 towers installed, ~90% geographic mobile coverage, service 'reaching 4G level' (government claim)
position_end: 184 towers and accessories installed; landline renovation in six named towns plus the Naval Force Base; ~73km new cable laid; internet bandwidth risen to ~1,536 Mbps over the past decade; 35bn+ Nakfa cumulative investment claimed
sources: 2026-05-19 Eritrea substantial investment in communication service expansion
note: Minister's own figures (state media); geographic coverage is not population coverage and is not independently verifiable

subject: infra.connect
name: Mobile broadband affordability
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: an entry-level mobile broadband basket at 85% of monthly gross national income per head, against a 2% affordability benchmark
note: no later Eritrea-specific affordability figure was located at the probe date

subject: infra.connect
name: Starlink satellite internet service
milestone: Starlink's own coverage-availability map lists Eritrea 'No planned launch date'
position_end: No planned launch date (17 Jul 2026); one of seven African states with no announced timeline, all in Northern Africa/the Horn; no evidence found of a licence application or refusal

subject: infra.connect
name: Submarine fibre-optic cable landing
milestone: Cable industry calls Eritrea a 'black hole' that does not answer landing requests; still cable-less as of Apr 2026
position_start: No cable landing; state did not respond to Red Sea route approaches from cable firms (2024)
position_end: No cable landing; not party to UNCLOS; EriTel's international transit runs on geostationary satellite
sources: 2024-06-10-cable-firms-eye-eritrea-red-sea-houthi-attacks|2026-04-16 The Long View - What ICT4D did for Africa and why that deep past matters for today
note: Submarine Networks industry registry lists Eritrea as the sole non-landing state among Africa's 38 coastal states, but that count is itself undated (adjacent stats stamped end-2019)

subject: dpi.exchange
name: ASYCUDA World customs platform
position_start: 2007-era paper-based customs software (no ASYCUDA)
position_end: ASYCUDA World implemented with UNDP support, full source-code transfer to the Eritrean government for national ownership
sources: 2026-01-08 Eritrea launches ASYCUDA World digital customs system

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Vulnerability database for social protection
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: a vulnerability database established in the labour and welfare ministry to collect and analyse gender-segregated data on persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups
note: the report does not state that this database exchanges data with any other system

subject: dpi.id
name: National foundational digital ID
milestone: Global Digital Identity Index profile finds no operational foundational ID; sets out the barriers a future system would face
position_end: No operational foundational digital ID; barriers profiled: low connectivity/mobile penetration, limited digital infrastructure, telecom monopoly (EriTel), weak civil registration
sources: 2025-07-26 Eritrea's population digital identity - challenges ahead

subject: dpi.pay
name: Mobile money / digital payments service
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — a regional peer assessment records a state-owned financial system with no cash machines, cards or internet banking
position_start: no mobile money or digital payment service on the record
position_end: unchanged, and now dated: the financial system is state-owned and offers simple, less sophisticated services with no automatic teller machines, debit or credit cards or internet banking
note: No named mobile-money or digital-payments system on file; base holds only the cash-based, under-banked context around the Bank of Eritrea deposit ultimatum (see gov.legislate)

subject: dpi.registry
name: Business Information Register
position_start: a statutory business information register maintained by the trade ministry, covering trade, manufacturing, services, fisheries and commercial farming, with specified fields and annual reporting
position_end: unchanged and still manual: an external assessment records no business-registration website and registration through six government offices

subject: dpi.registry
name: Cadastral Office and land register
position_start: a cadastral office responsible for registering all land, rights over land and transfers of property, on a tenure system in which all land belongs to the state
position_end: unchanged: the founding law does not establish the register's operational extent and nothing later on the base does either

subject: dpi.registry
name: National address and postcode system
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — Eritrea does not appear on the postal union's list of countries operating a postcode system
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: no national postcode system, on the postal union's own reference list

subject: dpi.registry
name: Voter register
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — the electoral law provides for a register but no national election has been held under it
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: an electoral law providing for an independent commission to prepare the register, issue voting cards and publish it for inspection, with nothing recording a register ever compiled
note: the hosted text is undated; the date is a proxy for the page access, not the law's promulgation

subject: dpi.registry
name: Zoba-level digital population registers
position_start: six separate regional digital population registers in place since 2001, with no central national register; residence and family identity cards are printed extracts of them
position_end: the same decentralised registers, with a five-year civil registration and vital statistics plan for 2024-2028 recognised by a regional treaty body

subject: dpi.mis
name: Education and teacher management information systems
position_start: an education management information system used to identify barriers and prioritise reforms, with a teacher management information system named as a planned enabling instrument
position_end: the same, with a ministry delegation attending a regional workshop to learn teacher management information system practice

subject: dpi.mis
name: National Health Information System
position_start: an established national health information system with a district platform rolled out to about 40% of secondary-level and above facilities, and interoperability between systems rated not there
position_end: the same system, with genomic sequencing capacity built at the national laboratory since 2024 and applied nationally to malaria and antimicrobial-resistance surveillance for the first time

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Online government services
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — the customs platform is the only operating government digital system on the base and it is internal, not citizen-facing
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: one internal system — a customs platform on an intranet architecture — and no citizen-facing online service
note: the e-government survey's country-level index values for Eritrea are not present in the captured text

subject: digital.localgov
name: ICT at sub-national government offices
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: a central ministry network and internet server with six regions and 30 of 55 sub-regions on dial-up, and no computer at all in 25 of 55 sub-regional offices
note: this is the most recent assessment of sub-national office ICT located; it is more than two decades old

subject: tech.ai
name: Agricultural expert system
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: an expert system described by the agriculture ministry as part of artificial intelligence, giving farmers guidance when extension workers are unavailable, inside an information system division established in 2019

subject: tech.ai
name: Control of artificial-intelligence abuse
status: Not held, searched 2026-08-31 — no domestic law, regulator or takedown route exists; the only response on the record is external fact-checking
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: AI-generated images and video inflaming war narratives, circulating from accounts on both sides, met only by external fact-checking

subject: tech.ai
name: Eri-Chat offline AI app
milestone: Q&A profile of developer Naod Goitom Isaac; app launched April 2025, showcased at Asmara UN Day event, Oct 2025
position_start: Live since April 2025 (pre-window launch), offline open-source-AI app storing conversation data locally on-device
position_end: Live; showcased at Asmara UN Day event (24 Oct 2025) to ambassadors, UN officials and diplomats; English-only, local-language support pending (insufficient training data)
note: Built by a Ministry of Information software developer; a rare concrete Eritrean AI/innovation data point. Launch dated to month only (April 2025)

subject: tech.innovate
name: Shambko Apps Group Tigrinya-language applications
milestone: Five applications released, described in a 2026-08-15 interview
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: Five Tigrinya-language mobile applications released by a self-organised software collective - literacy, puzzle, cultural-heritage and arithmetic tools built to the national curriculum - with a stated plan to extend to Eritrea's eight other national languages; no download count, distribution channel or funding source is stated
note: a self-organised private collective rather than a state programme, described in the state information ministry's own interview

subject: tech.innovate
name: Youth Innovation and Entrepreneurship Hub
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: a hub established in 2023 by the national youth union running three levels of six-month technical training in electronics, Python, Scratch, robotics and soldering, mainly for secondary students

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital training for government employees
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: one regional vocational-training activity in computer technology and networking for 108 government employees and force members, 63 of them women
note: no standing nationwide civil-service digital-skills scheme was located

subject: capacity.training
name: Mai Nefhi College of Engineering and Technology
position_start: a college offering computer engineering degrees and computer, communication and electrical technology diplomas within the national institute of technology
position_end: the same college showing 26 research papers and engineering solutions, 32 illustrations and 29 demonstrations at its engineering day, from 1,694 students of whom 39% are women

subject: include.access
name: EriTel internet complaint form
position_start: the base carries no position at the start of the period
position_end: a live web form for internet-connectivity and web-application complaints operated by the state telecommunications provider, with telephone and email alternatives

subject: include.divides
name: Active mobile connections (DataReportal)
position_start: 793,000 connections, 22.2% of population, 48.0% broadband (early 2025)
position_end: 859,000 connections, 23.7% of population, 49.3% broadband (late 2025), +8.2% year on year
note: Among the lowest mobile-penetration rates in Africa

subject: data.statistics
name: Fourth Round Eritrea Population and Health Survey (EPHS 2025)
milestone: NSO reports survey completion: 9,794 households, 405 enumeration areas, 98.4% household completion, CAPI digital collection
position_end: Completed across all six regions using Computer-Assisted Personal Interviewing; ~400 tables across 20 chapters drafted; report writing, printing and dissemination scheduled for 2026; NSO also compiled 2023 national accounts and began 2024 national-accounts data collection
sources: 2026-05-08 Eritrea strengthens data systems with EPHS 2025 (UNDP)
note: Technical support from Mikro International Consultancy Service (Oslo) and UNECA, under the UNDP-led Joint Programme on Data for Development (D4D); Eritrea's most concrete data-systems development on record
